name: American Auto
description: In the headquarters of a major American automotive company in Detroit, a floundering group of executives at Payne Motors must adapt to the changing times or be sent to the junkyard.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Payne Motors gets a new CEO on the same day they’re rolling out a new self-driving — and problematic — vehicle

videos.title: White Van
videos.overview: Katherine deals with the PR fallout of a serial killer driving a Payne; Jack tries to figure out his role in the company

videos.title: Earnings Call
videos.overview: Katherine promises a big announcement on her first quarterly earnings call. Jack and Elliot negotiate a contract with the line workers union.

videos.title: The $10K Car
videos.overview: Sadie and Cyrus struggle with how honest to be about Katherine’s car idea. Elliot pawns his vicious dog off on Dori.

videos.title: Millbank, IA
videos.overview: The group travels to Iowa for the opening of a new factory.

videos.title: Commercial
videos.overview: Katherine and the team reshoot a commercial to make it more inclusive of the LGBTQ+ community.

videos.title: Recall
videos.overview: The executives realize a Payne vehicle may have a faulty part and debate whether to issue a recall.

videos.title: Employee Morale
videos.overview: Katherine and the team attempt to boost employee morale after the Payne CFO announces his resignation.

videos.title: Charity Dinner
videos.overview: The group attends the annual Payne Foundation Fundraising Gala. Katherine suspects her job may be in jeopardy. Wesley deals with a family rivalry.

videos.title: Profile
videos.overview: When a TV newsmagazine films a segment on Katherine, the team struggles to portray her in a positive light while avoiding “gotcha” questions.

videos.title: Crisis
videos.overview: Katherine and the team bring in crisis manager Ian Osofsky to help combat the negative publicity the company is receiving from accusations it covered up defective auto parts.

videos.title: Most Hated CEO
videos.overview: Ian and Sadie attempt to rehab Katherine's image from the pawl controversy by staging a phony video with Katherine's family and a visit to Late Night with Seth Meyers.

videos.title: Celebrity
videos.overview: When Payne loses their spokesperson, Katherine and the team go to great lengths to woo a new celebrity — Andy Richter — only to have second thoughts.

videos.title: Cost Cutting
videos.overview: In an effort to reduce costs, Jack, Cyrus and Elliot have to let go of some employees while Wesley and Dori search for office savings. Sadie helps prep Katherine for her first post-crisis TV interview.

videos.title: Going Green
videos.overview: Katherine and the team head to Silicon Valley to invest in green tech, including Sandbox, a potentially bogus company founded by Wesley’s friend, Chase.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: Katherine has to go on a "listening tour" after a group of younger employees demand the company stop contributing to "pro-life" politicians. The men of the office are charged with writing Payne's policies regarding abortion.

videos.title: Young Designers
videos.overview: Payne sponsors its annual young designers contest at a local elementary school, which sparks controversy when Katherine inadvertently offends multiple countries via an Instagram Live interview with a Somali American student.

videos.title: Hack
videos.overview: The Payne servers get hacked, causing Katherine and Elliot to conflict on whether or not to pay the ransom. This becomes increasingly more personal for Katherine when the hackers reveal they have personal photos of her.

videos.title: Night Out
videos.overview: The gang ends up at Katherine's house for what seems like an innocent night of drinking and employee bonding, but things escalate when everyone learns that Katherine and Richard are in the middle of a divorce.

videos.title: Passion Project
videos.overview: Coming off the news of her divorce, Katherine wants to institute big changes in the office, which prompts Cyrus to introduce her to his dream car. However, things go south when Katherine attempts to transform his design into a vision of her own.

videos.title: Funeral
videos.overview: When Wesley's grandfather passes away, Katherine and the others learn that all the heirs plan to sell their company shares, which would tank the stock price; they attempt damage control at the funeral to try to stop it.

videos.title: Dealer Event
videos.overview: Katherine is deathly afraid of rodents but is forced to drive a Pika filled with rabbits for the annual dealer event. Wesley takes Jack under his wing, teaching him how to schmooze the dealers.

videos.title: Judgment Day
videos.overview: Katherine and her team make one last effort to raise the Payne stock and save their jobs by rallying behind the launch of the Pika; when global events cause the whole market to crash, Katherine loses hope that Payne will ever recover.
